Welcome. This site hosts the slides, notes, and labs for the course.

## How to use this site

- Each topic has a notes page with the slides embedded at the top.
- Slides open full screen from the link under each deck. Press **F** for full screen and **S** for speaker view.
- Labs are runnable Python notebooks.

Graded work, solutions, and grades live in Canvas, not here.
